summary: A campus app showing add, drop and withdrawal deadlines per section, with Registrar's Office exceptions. It holds Internal data and writes only its own records. One flag for Security: an exception form posts free text that is rendered without escaping.

checks.evidence: PASSPORT.yml validates against passport schema version 1.
LICENSE is Apache-2.0, matching the passport.
Every generated page carries a robots noindex meta tag.

controls.evidence: Entra sign-in is enforced by the container app module.
server/api/exceptions.post.ts calls the layer's role check before writing.
The builder confirms it on the ready-call form.

flags.detail: Exception notes are rendered with v-html.
